name: Algebraic Curves
description: Plane curves: historical context and classical examples; Affine space and projective space, Zariski topology, coordinate rings, projective space, homogenization; Morphisms between varieties, rational maps, birational equivalence; Function fields, birational isomorphism; Derivations, Jacobians, smooth points, singular points; Local rings, completions, formal local parameters; Multiplicities, intersections of plane curves, Bézout's theorem; Divisors, principal divisors, linear equivalence, degree; Linear systems, dimension of divisor spaces; Statement of Riemann-Roch. Canonical divisors, genus, Elliptic curve, applications of Riemann-Roch.
